info.title: Affiliate CRM API
info.description: REST API for the Affiliate CRM. Source of truth: docs/api-contract.md. Money is VND as integers; dates are ISO 8601 UTC.

ErrorCode.description: Machine-readable code on business errors (403 disabled account, 409, 422).

field.description: Dotted path of the invalid field, e.g. "customerPhone".

code.description: Machine-readable code on business errors (403 disabled account, 409, 422).

phone.description: Vietnamese mobile number. Accepted as 0XXXXXXXXX, +84XXXXXXXXX or 84XXXXXXXXX; spaces, dots, dashes and parentheses are ignored. Stored and returned as 0XXXXXXXXX (10 digits, prefix 03/05/07/08/09).

refreshToken.description:
Opaque token, valid for 7 days, single use: every refresh returns a new
one. Deprecated in the body (contract v0.6): it is also set as the
httpOnly `crm_rt` cookie, and v0.7 removes it from the body.

accessToken.description: JWT, valid for 15 minutes. Send as `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`.

expiresIn.description: Seconds until the access token expires.

total.description: Total number of items across all pages.

note.description: Free text from the affiliate, shown in the timeline.

assignee.description: Set on ASSIGNED entries: who the lead was assigned to.

reason.example: Khách hàng huỷ hợp đồng trong 15 ngày

month.description: Payout period (Vietnam calendar); includes APPROVED commissions created up to its end.

leadsByStatus.description: Number of leads created in [from, to), by current status

commissionByStatus.description: Commission amounts in VND (sum) for commissions created in [from, to), by status

commission.description: VND, commissions created in the range, excluding CANCELLED.
